cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/code.name: Bounded saved-game documents
cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/code.description: Encodes and strictly reconstructs versioned saved games without performing filesystem operations.

cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/dto..name: Saved history representation
cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/dto..description: Maps saved documents into checked game values without silently repairing or normalizing stored history.

cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/file.name: Safe Linux file access
cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/file.description: Uses directory-relative operations that avoid following hostile filesystem links.

cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/help.name: Supervised save helpers
cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/help.description: Runs one bounded isolated storage child per operation and dispatches the private helper entry.

cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/help.name: Private save-helper messages
cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/help.description: Encodes requests, replies and failures between the parent process and its storage child.

cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/migr.name: Save format version checks
cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/migr.description: Recognizes the current Rust save version and rejects unsupported versions; no older Rust format has shipped.

cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/mod..name: Local save connection assembly
cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/mod..description: Exposes saved-document validation, atomic local storage and supervised helper access.

cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/prep.name: Private save preparation
cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/prep.description: Keeps exact encoded save bytes behind an opaque attempt handle recoverable only by the creating adapter.

cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/repo.name: Atomic write failure tests
cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/repo.description: Exercises injected filesystem faults and crash windows around save replacement and reconciliation.

cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/repo.name: Atomic game saves
cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/repo.description: Locks save slots and writes primary and backup documents atomically, with same-attempt reconciliation.

cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/save.name: New save-slot identities
cyoa-infrastructure/src/persistence/save.description: Generates stable slot identities for local and supervised repositories.
